title: Your 4% Raise Is Actually a Pay Cut
hook: You celebrated your raise — but if inflation ran above that, your boss just handed you a pay cut wrapped in good news.
angle: The inflation illusion makes workers feel rewarded while real purchasing power silently shrinks — and HR departments plan it that way
audience: Salaried workers who got a raise but still feel like money is tight
key_numbers: $2,700 lost in purchasing power on a $70K salary
$18,000 gap over 10 years of raises that barely beat inflation
